title: Fabric Supersat notebook properties
description: src/Notebooks/<Name>/<Name>.yaml: properties of the Fabric notebook in this folder. The notebook's name is its folder name.

description.description: The notebook's description in Fabric. Upload sets it; "" clears it. Without it, upload leaves the description in Fabric as it is.

folder.description: The workspace folder the notebook is in, as a path of folder names such as "Bronze/Ingest", matched by name in each workspace. Upload creates any missing folders and moves the notebook there; "" is the workspace root. Without it, upload leaves the notebook where it is in Fabric (new notebooks go in the root). Folder names can't contain ~ " # . & * : < > ? { | } or start or end with a space; at most 10 levels.
